intro: The power died an hour ago. Somebody wanted you in the dark. Find a way out.
ending: Cold air rushes in. Beyond the door the city glitters under a wet night sky, and for the first time tonight you can see where you're going.

rooms.name: Electrical Room
rooms.description: A lone lamp swings overhead. Beyond its light, the walls hum.

items.name: flashbulb
items.floor_text: A flashbulb lies in the light.
items.inspect: A press flashbulb with one shot left. Not yours: somebody took pictures in here tonight. One flash would show what the lamp can't.
items.refusal: You've got one flash. Save it for somewhere the lamp can't reach.

containers.name: toolbox
containers.closed_text: A toolbox waits on the floor.
containers.inspect: Your own toolbox, dented and familiar. Somebody went through it tonight and put everything back, almost right.

contents.name: screwdriver
contents.inspect: A worn flathead. The tip is just the width of the screws on the fuse box.

contents.name: wrench
contents.inspect: Heavy and rusted, the jaws set wide. Too big for anything in here but the bolts on the vent.

containers.name: fuse box
containers.closed_text: A fuse box is screwed shut.

room_text.power on: The fuse box hums; a red light glows by the door.

inspect.closed: Grey steel, four flathead screws. Fresh scratches round every one. Somebody had this open tonight.
inspect.open: A neat row of fuses with one empty socket. Nothing blew in here. That fuse was pulled out by hand.
inspect.power on: Every socket full. The box hums, and over by the door a small red light is awake.

uses.refusal: The fuse box is screwed shut.
uses.text: You press the fuse home. The box hums, the lamp steadies, and by the door a small red light wakes up.

contents.name: key
contents.inspect: Small and brass, on a paper tag. In a woman's hand: "For when you wake up. V."

room_text.closed: A vent sits low in the dark.
room_text.open: The vent hangs open, black inside.
room_text.flashed: The vent hangs open, its duct gone dark again.

inspect.closed: A low grille held by four rusted bolts. The dust on the bolt heads has been wiped clean.
inspect.open: The duct runs back into pitch black. The lamp can't reach in there. You'd need a flash to see.
inspect.flashed: The flash burned the duct onto your eyes: dust, and a clean track where something was pushed in tonight.

uses.refusal: The grille is bolted shut. Get it open first.
uses.text: The bulb pops. For an instant the duct is white as noon, and just inside lies a fuse wrapped in silk.

contents.name: fuse
contents.inspect: A good glass fuse, wrapped in a silk handkerchief with a V stitched in the corner. Pulled, not blown.

door.refusal: The key won't turn. The electric bolt holds it, dead as the lights.
door.unlock_text: The key turns. With a hum, the electric bolt slides back.

room_text.unlocked: The door is unlocked, a green light over its keyhole.
room_text.open: The door stands open on the night.

inspect.locked: Steel. A brass keyhole under the handle, and above it an electric bolt with a dead light. Without power, no key will move it.
inspect.unlocked: The bolt is drawn back and a green light glows over the keyhole. Nothing holds the door now.
inspect.open: The door stands open on a wet, glittering night.
